chapters.title: Art, literature and science: ancient India (to 647 CE)
chapters.intro: Seals and bronzes of Harappa, Mauryan pillars and caves, the stupas of Sanchi and Amaravati, the Gandhara and Mathura schools, Ajanta, Gupta temples, Panini, Kalidasa, Aryabhata and the first Telugu inscription. Read with the history chapters of the same years.

fragments.title: Harappa to the Mauryas
fragments.intro: Harappan art, Taxila, Panini, Mauryan caves.

fragments.title: Stupas, sculpture and Sangam
fragments.intro: Andhra Buddhist sites, Sanchi, Gandhara–Mathura–Amaravati, Ayurveda, Natyashastra, Panchatantra.

fragments.title: The classical age
fragments.intro: Tamil epics, Gupta temples, Ajanta, Aryabhata, Varahamihira, Kalamalla, Aihole, Brahmagupta.

takeaways: Gandhara (grey schist), Mathura (red sandstone), Amaravati (white limestone).
Ajanta: Vakataka Harishena; Aihole: cradle of temple architecture.
Aryabhatiya 499 CE; Kalamalla c. 575 CE first full Telugu inscription.
chapters.source: NCERT Class 12 Themes in Indian History I, Ch. 1 "Bricks, Beads and Bones"; NCERT Class 12 Themes in Indian History I, Ch. 4 "Thinkers, Beliefs and Buildings"; Andhra Pradesh history (AP SCERT / Telugu Akademi syllabus)

chapters.title: Art, literature and religion: medieval India (648–1756)
chapters.intro: Pallava, Chola, Hoysala and Kalinga temples; Alvars, Nayanars, Shankara, Ramanuja, Basavanna and the Sufis; the Qutb Minar and Mughal monuments; and Telugu from Nannaya and the Kavitrayam to the Ashtadiggajas, Annamacharya, Vemana and Kuchipudi.

fragments.title: Temples and the first Telugu poets
fragments.intro: Mamallapuram, Alvars, Pampa, Khajuraho, Tirumala, Dilwara, Nannaya, Simhachalam, Belur, Puri, Rajatarangini, Gita Govinda, Palkuriki Somanatha.

fragments.title: Sufis, saints and Kakatiya art
fragments.intro: Chishti, Qutb Minar, Ramappa, Madhva, Konark, Tikkana, Jnaneshwar, Ranganatha Ramayanam, Srinatha, Annamacharya and Potana, Chaitanya, Hampi, Ashtadiggajas.

fragments.title: Mughal, Qutb Shahi and Telugu culture
fragments.intro: Lepakshi, Molla, Mughal painting, Humayun's tomb, Tulsidas, Kondapalli, Kuchipudi, Taj Mahal, Mecca Masjid, Kshetrayya, Vemana, Vengamamba.

takeaways: Kavitrayam: Nannaya, Tikkana, Errana; Ashtadiggajas under Krishnadevaraya.
Ramappa temple 1213 (UNESCO 2021); Qutb Minar begun by Aibak.
chapters.source: NCERT Class 7 Our Pasts II; NCERT Class 12 Themes in Indian History II, Ch. 6 "Bhakti-Sufi Traditions"; NCERT Class 12 Themes in Indian History II, Ch. 7 "An Imperial Capital: Vijayanagara"; Andhra Pradesh history (AP SCERT / Telugu Akademi syllabus)

chapters.title: Literary awakening and modern culture (1757–2026)
chapters.intro: Tyagaraja, C.P. Brown and the Telugu revival, Ravi Varma, Gidugu's spoken Telugu, bhava kavitvam, nationalist and Dalit poetry, cinema, Burrakatha, Sri Sri, the national symbols, the academies and the Telugu Jnanpith winners — syllabus sections 8 and 9.

fragments.title: Literature of the national movement
fragments.intro: Bengal School, Gidugu, cinema, Rayaprolu, Garimella, Unnava, Jashuva, Burrakatha.

fragments.title: Culture after independence
fragments.intro: National symbols, Sri Sri, the academies, Jnanpith, GI handlooms.

takeaways: C.P. Brown published Vemana (1829) and a dictionary (1852).
First Telugu talkie Bhakta Prahlada (1931); first Telugu Jnanpith Viswanatha (1970).
chapters.source: Andhra Pradesh history (AP SCERT / Telugu Akademi syllabus)
